description: Harmony: a standalone VS Code chat participant + agent that uses VS Code language models, workspace tools, and an optional local backend.
configuration.title: Harmony
config.harmony.backendUrl.description: URL of the optional local backend HTTP endpoint.
config.harmony.language.description: Language for Harmony chat responses and sidebar UI. 'zh' for Chinese (中文).
config.harmony.modelProvider.description: Model source for the native @harmony participant. 'vscode-lm' uses the model selected in VS Code Chat. 'deepseek', 'alibaba', 'tencent', 'zhipu', 'zhipu-coding', and 'moonshot' call their OpenAI-compatible direct APIs using stored provider keys. Provider primary models use their coding-tier setting.
config.harmony.collabProvider.enum.0: Harmony — sub-agents always call Harmony's own provider (e.g. DeepSeek direct API). VS Code LM is never used.
config.harmony.collabProvider.enum.1: VS Code — sub-agents always use the model VS Code chat resolves.
config.harmony.collabProvider.enum.2: Mix — prefer VS Code LM; fall back to Harmony's provider when VS Code LM is unavailable.
config.harmony.collabProvider.descriptio: Routing mode for collaborative sub-agents and the local agent loop.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.enum.0: Auto / Balanced — recommended default. Uses a coding-tier direct provider when Route needs Harmony. Prefers Gemini only when Gemini free-quota mode is enabled.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.enum.1: Economy / Fast — use light-tier models for routine collaborative scouts and lower-intensity sessions.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.enum.2: Balanced — explicit balanced profile, currently equivalent to coding tier for collaborative agents.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.enum.3: Power / Hard Sessions — use heavy-tier models with premium/cost guards.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.enum.4: Custom — use harmony.collabDirectProvider and harmony.collabDirectTier exactly.
config.harmony.collabModelPreset.descrip: Model profile for Harmony direct collaborative agents. This is separate from harmony.modelProvider and harmony.collabProvider.
config.harmony.collabDirectProvider.desc: Direct provider used by collaborative agents when harmony.collabModelPreset is custom, or as an explicit provider preference for direct Agents routing. Gemini uses the AI Studio / Google Generative Language API key stored as harmony.geminiApiKey; Vertex AI is not wired here.
config.harmony.collabDirectTier.descript: Direct provider tier used by collaborative agents when harmony.collabModelPreset is custom. Heavy/premium routes still respect Harmony cost guards.
Use the standard DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
DeepSeek endpoint profile. Use custom only if DeepSeek issues a different regional or proxy base URL.
config.harmony.deepseekModel.enum.0: DeepSeek Flash (V4.1) — newest fast route, thinking ON by default. Surpasses V4 Pro.
config.harmony.deepseekModel.description: DeepSeek model to use when harmony.modelProvider is 'deepseek'.
config.harmony.deepseekThinking.descript: Enable DeepSeek extended thinking at the API level. Harmony preserves the reasoning content internally when tool loops continue.
config.harmony.deepseekShowThinking.desc: Show DeepSeek reasoning as a full Markdown thinking block before each response/tool step. Harmony strips the visible block from replayed assistant history and preserves reasoning internally as DeepSeek reasoning_content.
config.harmony.deepseekMaxHistoryMessage: Maximum prior chat request/response messages to replay into DeepSeek direct API calls. Keeps long or failed chats from contaminating new tool routing. Set 0 to disable history replay.
config.harmony.deepseekMaxHistoryChars.d: Maximum characters of prior chat history to replay into DeepSeek direct API calls after sanitizing assistant output. Set 0 to disable history replay.
config.harmony.streamIdleTimeoutSec.desc: Seconds without receiving any stream data before a provider request is aborted with a clear timeout error instead of hanging. 0 disables the idle timeout.
config.harmony.lmDirectFallback.descript: When the VS Code Chat model route fails mid-turn, automatically reroute the turn to the first Harmony direct provider with a saved API key (coding-plan providers first). Disable to let vscode-lm turns fail without an auto-rescue attempt.
config.harmony.parallelToolBatching.desc: Run independent read-only tool calls (file reads, git reads) concurrently within a single turn to reduce latency. Disable if you observe any tool-ordering issues.
config.harmony.logRawStream.description: Log raw DeepSeek API streaming chunks to the Harmony Debug output channel. Use temporarily for debugging.
config.harmony.enableDebugLogging.descri: Log Harmony tool registry, routing, parser, and invocation diagnostics to the Harmony Debug output channel. Does not include API keys.
config.harmony.showDiagnosticsOnError.de: Show a concise expandable diagnostic block when a Harmony turn fails. This never includes API keys or hidden reasoning.
config.harmony.agentMaxSteps.description: Maximum number of agent steps (tool/reasoning loops) per user message. Default 12 prevents runaway cost; set a larger number for long autonomous sessions or -1 for unlimited.
config.harmony.autoApproveTools.descript: Skip confirmation dialogs for write_file and run_terminal tool calls. Turn on for uninterrupted agent sessions.
config.harmony.careBloom.threshold.descr: Number of engagements with the same tool+file before a Wisdom Sprout blooms. Lower = more frequent reflections.
config.harmony.errorLearning.enabled.des: When enabled, CareBloom learns from resolved error patterns and proactively advises when similar failures are detected.
config.harmony.orchestrateMode.enabled.d: When enabled, read-only orchestration tools (parallel dispatch, model consulting, swarm dispatch) are pre-approved. File writes and terminal commands still require confirmation.
config.harmony.orchestrateMode.preApprov: Tool names that are automatically approved when Orchestrate Mode is active.
config.harmony.orchestrateMode.maxCallsP: Maximum orchestration calls allowed per session when Orchestrate Mode is active (0 = unlimited). When exceeded, mode auto-disables.
config.harmony.orchestrateMode.sessionTi: Auto-disable Orchestrate Mode after N minutes of inactivity (0 = never).
config.harmony.deepOrchestrate.enabled.d: Enable the DeepOrchestrate safe copy-edit-review pipeline. When ON, all file edits go through .harmony/orchestrate-drafts/ with multi-model review before atomic application.
config.harmony.deepOrchestrate.autoRevie: Automatically run multi-model review after drafting (instead of requiring human gate approval first). Humans still confirm before final application.
config.harmony.deepOrchestrate.reviewDep: Number of AI models reviewing DeepOrchestrate diffs (1-3). More reviewers = safer but slower and costlier.
config.harmony.deepOrchestrate.maxCostPe: Maximum estimated cost per DeepOrchestrate operation in USD. Operations exceeding this are blocked.
config.harmony.whisper.retentionDays.des: Number of days to retain whisper files before cleanup. Archived whispers older than this are permanently deleted.
Allowed from names for concert hall posts. Names not in this list are remapped to ensemble. Add custom names here to personalize your concert hall.
config.harmony.whisper.disabled.descript: Disable the whisper inbox entirely. When disabled, whispers return a message and cannot bypass the block.
config.harmony.workerOutputs.enabled.des: Save complete worker/spawn outputs to .harmony/worker-outputs/ to prevent truncation.
config.harmony.centralHubPath.descriptio: Absolute path to the private Central Hub folder containing scripts/self_healing_harness.py. Leave blank in shared builds; set locally or via HARMONY_CENTRAL_HUB/EHAI_CENTRAL_PATH.
config.harmony.extensionSourcePath.descr: Absolute path to the HarmonyExtension source folder. Used by self-inspection, compile/package/install, and repair restore tools. Leave blank to auto-detect common local paths.
config.harmony.centralPythonPath.descrip: Optional absolute path to the Python executable for the Central Hub harness. If blank, Harmony tries the Central Hub .venv and then python on PATH.
config.harmony.creativeServicePath.descr: Optional absolute path to the Harmony Creative REST service folder containing rest_api.py, or to a workspace/root containing harmony-creative or mcp-servers/harmony-creative. If blank, Harmony checks the current workspace, then Central.
config.harmony.creativePythonPath.descri: Optional absolute path to the Python executable for Harmony Creative. If blank, Harmony tries the Creative .venv, the owning workspace/Central .venv, then python on PATH.
config.harmony.enableMemoryHub.descripti: If true, the Harmony participant will POST each (prompt, response) pair to the optional local memory hub at hub.url/ext/v1/memory/store (default http://127.0.0.1:7878). Failures are silent.
config.harmony.planOnlyMode.description: When true, Harmony cannot call write/edit/patch/run-terminal tools — she can only read, list, grep, open, and ask questions. Useful for planning-before-doing sessions.
config.harmony.bigGunsMode.description: Cost guard. 'off' = ask before any expensive model. 'deepseek-only' = allow DeepSeek Pro automatically (cheap), but ask for Gemini Pro / Opus. 'all' = auto-allow all.
config.harmony.contextPersistence.preAct: Approach A: Before every edit/compile tool, re-read the active todo items and confirm which are planned vs completed.
config.harmony.contextPersistence.swarmV: Approach C: Dispatch a verifier agent after each turn to cross-check planned todos against actual file/directory state.
config.harmony.contextPersistence.active: Approach D: Maximum number of todo items to keep active at once. Completed items auto-archive.
config.harmony.contextPersistence.checkp: Approach B: Number of tool calls after which Harmony injects a [CHECKPOINT] message requiring todo progress review.
config.harmony.plannerEnforced.descripti: When true, Harmony MUST call harmony_todo to lay out a plan before executing any 3+ step request.
config.harmony.checkpointMode.descriptio: When true, Harmony pauses and asks the user before each major step (file write, multi-line edit, terminal command).
config.harmony.continuity.autoInjectLate: When true, Harmony injects the latest explicit continuity/handoff entry into new model turns so work can resume across Harmony, Copilot, Gemini, terminal, and future seats.
config.harmony.continuity.maxPromptChars: Maximum detail characters from the latest continuity entry to inject into a model prompt.
config.harmony.rules.enabled.description: Load project rule anchors such as AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, HARMONY.md, and .harmony/rules/*.md into Harmony model prompts.
config.harmony.rules.includePrivateFiles: Include private rule/planning files in Harmony model prompts. Default false to avoid sending private notes to cloud models accidentally.
config.harmony.rules.maxPromptChars.desc: Maximum total characters of rule anchor content to inject into Harmony prompts.
config.harmony.orchestrator.maxFiles.des: Default maximum files included in harmony_orchestrate_codebase repo packs.
config.harmony.orchestrator.maxContextCh: Default maximum characters included in harmony_orchestrate_codebase repo packs. Raise for large-context models after checking cost.
config.harmony.orchestrator.includePriva: Include private planning files in codebase orchestrator packs. Default false for privacy.
config.harmony.verification.timeoutSec.d: Default timeout in seconds for verification commands.
config.harmony.mcp.enabled.description: Enable Harmony's MCP manager layer. The current version reports configured servers and permissions; runtime spawning is intentionally deferred.
config.harmony.mcp.servers.description: Configured MCP servers keyed by name. Each server may include enabled, transport ('stdio'|'http'), command, args, url, trust ('ask'|'allow'|'deny'), permissions, and timeoutSec.
config.harmony.claude.enableThinking.des: Enable extended thinking on Anthropic Claude model calls. DISABLED by default because thinking tokens are billed separately and can cause High impact on a single Opus call. Only enable intentionally for specialized deep-reasoning tasks, and pair it with harmony.claude.thinkingBudgetTokens to cap spend.
config.harmony.claude.thinkingBudgetToke: Maximum thinking tokens per Anthropic Claude model call when harmony.claude.enableThinking is true. 4000 tokens: Medium on Sonnet, High on Opus. A hard cap so accidental thinking spikes cannot exceed this.
config.harmony.gemini.useFreeQuota.descr: When true, Harmony makes Gemini calls without asserting billing requirements. The API enforces its own free-tier limits (15 req/min for Flash). Quota errors are surfaced clearly rather than silently burning credits. Your AI Studio key works on both free and paid paths — this setting just controls which path Harmony expects.
config.harmony.providers.selfHealFromEnv: When true, Harmony may silently write a provider key recovered from a workspace .env (or process environment) back into VS Code Secret Storage so other readers see it. When enabled, a forgotten manual Import isn't necessary — simply sending a message recovers the key from .env automatically. Off by default because it promotes a plaintext secret into encrypted storage without an explicit Import. Slot-saved keys always self-heal regardless of this setting.
config.harmony.providerAccounting.enable: Write a secret-free local audit ledger for provider calls and provider-policy blocks under .harmony/provider-usage/ledger.jsonl. Prompts, responses, and API keys are not stored.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.enabled.de: Enable local allow/deny/quota checks before Harmony direct-provider API calls. Disable only when intentionally bypassing provider policy.
config.harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.e: Enable real swarm mutation execution from escrow proposals. Disabled by default so swarm can plan, escrow, read, and dry-run but cannot apply patches, run commands, or call providers unless intentionally enabled.
config.harmony.swarm.patchExecution.enab: Enable real swarm patch execution through git apply. Requires harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.enabled, execution_guarded receipts, escrow, preflight, confirmation, and operation locks.
config.harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.e: Enable real terminal-command execution from swarm proposals and required swarm validation commands. Requires harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.enabled for proposal execution, execution_guarded receipts, escrow, preflight, confirmation, and operation locks.
config.harmony.swarm.providerCalls.enabl: Enable direct provider calls from swarm dispatch fan-out or swarm provider-call proposals. Disabled by default to prevent unexpected spend or data sharing; provider policy still applies when enabled.
config.harmony.swarm.defaultProvider.des: Default provider preference used by Harmony swarm launchers/direct controls when a provider choice is needed. DeepSeek resolves to DeepSeek V4 Flash by default. Provider calls remain disabled unless harmony.swarm.providerCalls.enabled is explicitly enabled.
config.harmony.swarm.defaultTier.descrip: Default provider tier used by Harmony swarm launchers/direct controls. With the default DeepSeek provider, coding resolves to deepseek-v4-flash.
config.harmony.swarm.autonomyExecution.e: Enable bounded swarm autonomy execute mode. Disabled by default; plan and dry-run modes remain available. Real execution still requires confirm_execute, validation, budgets, locks, and the relevant patch/terminal/provider switches. Validation commands also require harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.enabled.
config.harmony.swarm.commitExecution.ena: Enable guarded in-swarm git commit execution. Disabled by default; commit dry-run remains available. Real commits still require a ready dry-run receipt, snapshot receipt evidence, validation, clean checks, manifest-only staging, final confirmation, and harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.enabled for validation commands.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.allowedPro: Optional allow-list for direct provider calls. Empty means any configured provider is allowed unless denied.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.deniedProv: Providers that Harmony direct-provider calls must block before HTTP.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.allowedMod: Optional per-provider model allow-list for direct provider calls. Values are exact model IDs or * wildcards, e.g. { "openrouter": ["*:free", "tencent/*"] }. Empty provider list means any model not denied is allowed.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.deniedMode: Optional per-provider model deny-list for direct provider calls. Values are exact model IDs or * wildcards, e.g. { "openrouter": ["anthropic/*", "openai/*"] }. Deny rules are checked before HTTP and are also applied to OpenRouter fallbacks.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.maxSession: Maximum direct provider calls allowed in the current extension session. 0 disables this quota.
Maximum known estimated direct-provider cost allowed in the current extension session. 0 disables this quota. Unknown-cost providers are still shown as partly unknown.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.maxCallsBy: Optional per-provider direct-call quotas for the current extension session, e.g. { "gemini": 10, "openai": 2 }.
config.harmony.providerPolicy.maxEstimat: Optional per-provider known estimated-cost quotas for the current extension session, e.g. { "openai": 1.00, "claude": 0.50 }.
Default model tier for harmony_orchestrate_codebase. 'coding' maps to DeepSeek Flash by default — cheap, transparent billing, strong code reasoning. Change to 'heavy' only for questions that truly need the full model.
config.harmony.hub.url.description: Base URL for HarmonyHub, the local sovereign cross-project insight daemon. Default localhost:7878.
config.harmony.hub.autoStart.description: Allow explicit Hub-dependent actions to start HarmonyHub on demand. This does not start Hub at VS Code launch; turn off to require a prompt before starting the local index daemon.
config.harmony.hub.startOnMessage.enum.0: Do not start HarmonyHub from normal @harmony messages.
config.harmony.hub.startOnMessage.enum.1: Ask before starting HarmonyHub for a normal @harmony message when Hub is offline.
config.harmony.hub.startOnMessage.enum.2: Start HarmonyHub automatically for normal @harmony messages when Hub is offline.
config.harmony.hub.startOnMessage.descri: What Harmony should do when a normal @harmony message begins and HarmonyHub is offline. Prompt is recommended because first startup/indexing can use noticeable memory.
config.harmony.hub.indexOnStart.descript: When the Hub is online but its local index is empty, start one background index automatically (equivalent to clicking Re-index). This never starts the Hub or keeps it running; it only fills an empty index once. Turn off to require a manual Re-index.
config.harmony.hub.idleStopMinutes.descr: Minutes of work-based idle before HarmonyHub exits to free memory (0 = never exit). Only real requests reset the timer; status polls do not, and it never exits while an index is running. The Hub starts again on demand.
config.harmony.hub.idleUnloadMinutes.des: Minutes of work-based idle before HarmonyHub unloads the embedding model to free memory while staying running (0 = never unload). The next embedding request reloads the model. Applies only when it is less than 'Idle stop minutes', or when 'Idle stop minutes' is 0 (never exit).
config.harmony.hub.embedModel.descriptio: Embedding model used to build the local index. 'Jina code' (default) gives the best code-search quality. 'Fast MiniLM' builds several times faster but recalls code less accurately. Changing it makes the existing index incompatible (it is KEPT, never deleted) and needs one Re-index. Applies on the next Hub start.
config.harmony.hub.embedModel.enum.1: Fast MiniLM — 384-dim, much faster build, weaker code search.
config.harmony.hub.startPolicy.descripti: When Harmony is permitted to start HarmonyHub. This replaces the old auto-start toggle (an existing auto-start = off is honored as 'Never'). HarmonyHub is machine-scoped: it is shared by all VS Code windows and stops itself when idle.
config.harmony.hub.startPolicy.enum.0: Never start automatically. You must start Hub manually for local recall and indexing.
config.harmony.hub.startPolicy.enum.1: Start on demand, when a Hub-dependent action actually needs it. Recommended.
config.harmony.hub.startPolicy.enum.2: Start when a workspace opens. Uses memory on every window open, so it is off by default.
config.harmony.hub.restartPolicy.descrip: What Harmony does if HarmonyHub stops responding. Recovery is demand-driven (the Hub is restarted when something needs it). 'Prompt once' also offers a single recovery prompt per failure.
config.harmony.hub.restartPolicy.enum.0: Stay down and show the reason in the status bar. Recovery happens on the next Hub action.
config.harmony.hub.restartPolicy.enum.1: Show one 'start it again?' prompt per failure episode, in addition to status-bar reporting.
config.harmony.consensus.protocolPath.de: Path to a consensus protocol file (workspace-relative or absolute). The protocol declares the seats, rounds and rules.
config.harmony.consensus.ledgerDir.descr: Directory for consensus verdict ledgers. Each ledger is hash-bound to the artifacts it judged, so editing an artifact invalidates the verdict and requires a recheck.
config.harmony.consensus.maxRounds.descr: Default maximum rounds when a protocol does not set its own (1-7). Round 1 is independent; later rounds add peer review, beginning with a restatement of peers' positions.
config.harmony.consensus.convergence.des: Default convergence rule. unanimity: all seats agree. supermajority: most agree. rationale: agreement counts once every position change cites a reason.
Require each seat to restate peer positions accurately before agreeing or disagreeing. Reduces silent misreads.
config.harmony.consensus.requireRational: Require a cited reason for any position change (new evidence or corrected reasoning).
config.harmony.consensus.dissentPolicy.d: record: keep unresolved disagreement as a valid result. block: treat unresolved disagreement as a failed gate.
config.harmony.consensus.classifyDisagre: Label each disagreement as 'facts' (settleable by evidence) or 'values' (a preference that may persist).
config.harmony.consensus.maxProviderCall: Safety cap on automatic provider calls per round during dispatch (0-20). Protects against runaway cost.
config.harmony.hub.indexTimeoutMs.descri: How long (ms) Harmony watches a folder's index job before it stops waiting for the report. Indexing is asynchronous — the Hub keeps working in the background and saves progress incrementally — so stopping the wait never cancels the index or loses work. Default 15 min.
config.harmony.hub.allowedRoots.descript: Absolute folder paths HarmonyHub is allowed to index. Set once — the extension syncs them to the daemon automatically on startup and whenever the list changes.
config.harmony.sidebar.mode.enum.0: Show the full Harmony sidebar status surface with bounded lists and capped payloads.
config.harmony.sidebar.mode.enum.1: Show a lower-memory sidebar state that keeps controls visible but hides heavier detail lists until switched back to full.
config.harmony.sidebar.mode.enum.2: Show only minimal chat/diagnostic/restore controls and avoid live sidebar state fetches while isolating renderer OOMs.
config.harmony.sidebar.mode.description: Controls how much detail the Harmony sidebar renders. Isolated is the default renderer-OOM posture; compact keeps controls plus bounded summaries; full shows all capped details. You can also change this from Command Palette with Harmony: Configure Sidebar Display Mode.
config.harmony.hub.exePath.description: Optional absolute path to the HarmonyHub executable. If blank, Harmony uses the bundled binary first and then harmonyhub on PATH.
config.harmony.hub.dataDir.description: Data directory HarmonyHub stores its index snapshots in. Leave blank to use the default: a stable per-editor folder under ~/.harmony that survives extension reinstalls.
config.harmony.providers.openai.light.de: Override OpenAI light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openai.mid.desc: Override OpenAI mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openai.heavy.de: Override OpenAI heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openai.coding.d: Override OpenAI coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.gemini.light.de: Override Gemini light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.gemini.mid.desc: Override Gemini mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.gemini.heavy.de: Override Gemini heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.gemini.coding.d: Override Gemini coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.gemini.api.description: Gemini API dialect. auto uses native generateContent for thinking models. generateContent forces native. openai-compat forces compat.
config.harmony.gemini.thinking.level.des: Gemini thinking level for native generateContent API.
config.harmony.gemini.safety.preset.desc: Gemini safety settings. permissive sets BLOCK_NONE (recommended for agent loops).
config.harmony.providers.claude.light.de: Override Anthropic Claude light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.claude.mid.desc: Override Anthropic Claude mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.claude.heavy.de: Override Anthropic Claude heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.claude.coding.d: Override Anthropic Claude coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override DeepSeek light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.deepseek.mid.de: Override DeepSeek mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override DeepSeek heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.deepseek.coding: Override DeepSeek coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openrouter.ligh: Override OpenRouter light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override OpenRouter mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openrouter.heav: Override OpenRouter heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.openrouter.codi: Override OpenRouter coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override Moonshot/Kimi light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.moonshot.mid.de: Override Moonshot/Kimi mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override Moonshot/Kimi heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.moonshot.coding: Override Moonshot/Kimi coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Use the standard Moonshot/Kimi OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Moonshot/Kimi endpoint profile. Use custom only if Moonshot issues a different regional or proxy base URL.
config.harmony.kimiCode.contextWindow.de: KimiCode context window in tokens. Default 262144 (256k) for Moderato plan. Set to 1048576 (1M) for Allegretto+ plan.
config.harmony.providers.alibaba.light.d: Override Alibaba/Qwen light-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.alibaba.mid.des: Override Alibaba/Qwen mid-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.providers.alibaba.heavy.d: Override Alibaba/Qwen heavy-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
Override Alibaba/Qwen coding-tier model (leave empty for the built-in default).
config.harmony.alibaba.baseUrl.descripti: Alibaba DashScope/Model Studio OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Change to a regional endpoint if your account requires it.
config.harmony.alibaba.endpointProfile.e: International/Singapore/global DashScope endpoint. Use this for international keys.
Mainland China/Beijing DashScope endpoint. Use this for mainland China keys; international keys commonly return 401 here.
US/Virginia issued keys use the shared international OpenAI-compatible endpoint unless Alibaba issues a different account-specific URL.
Use harmony.alibaba.baseUrl exactly for any provider-issued regional endpoint.
config.harmony.alibaba.endpointProfile.d: Alibaba/Qwen endpoint profile. International is the Singapore/global route; US/Virginia uses that shared international route unless overridden; mainland is the China/Beijing route; custom uses the exact provider-issued base URL.
config.harmony.vision.geminiModel.descri: Gemini model used for image analysis when you attach screenshots in the Harmony Compose panel.
config.harmony.vision.provider.descripti: Vision provider. auto=configurable fallback order. Single-provider modes skip fallback.
config.harmony.vision.qwenModel.descript: Alibaba Qwen vision model for image analysis. qwen3.8-max and qwen3.7-plus are the current generation; qwen-vl-* are legacy.
config.harmony.vision.deepseekModel.desc: DeepSeek vision model for image analysis (experimental multimodal flash).
config.harmony.vision.ocrOnly.descriptio: When ON, Compose images are processed with local Windows OCR only — no API call. If OCR finds no text, the image is skipped (no fallback to paid vision). Turn ON to guarantee zero-cost, zero-cloud image processing.
config.harmony.vision.localFirst.descrip: When ON, images are analyzed locally first using CPU-only algorithms (dominant colors, blur detection, composition analysis) before falling back to cloud vision. Zero API cost, zero data sent off-device. Falls through to your chosen provider if local analysis fails.
config.harmony.vision.autoGeminiModel.de: Gemini model used when the vision provider is set to Auto (Gemini-first or Qwen-first fallback mode).
config.harmony.vision.autoQwenModel.desc: Alibaba Qwen vision model used when the vision provider is set to Auto (Gemini-first or Qwen-first fallback mode).
config.harmony.imageGen.provider.descrip: Default provider for harmony_image_gen. Gemini is preferred by default; switch to OpenAI for DALL-E/gpt-image generation or Alibaba for Tongyi Wanxiang.
config.harmony.imageGen.geminiModel.desc: Gemini image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is gemini. Legacy preview names are retried with gemini-2.5-flash-image after a 404.
config.harmony.imageGen.openaiModel.desc: OpenAI image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is openai.
config.harmony.imageGen.alibabaModel.des: Alibaba Tongyi Wanxiang image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is alibaba.
config.harmony.imageGen.autoApprove.desc: When true, Harmony can call paid image-generation APIs without asking each time. Leave OFF as a cost guard.
config.harmony.localEngine.enabled.descr: When ON, Harmony may probe and route private requests to local engines (Sovereign / Ollama). Default OFF so Harmony never spins up local processes mid-coding without explicit opt-in.
config.harmony.privacyRouting.descriptio: Where private local content is allowed to go. 'enterprise-only' (default): enterprise provider only. 'share-private': enterprise OR local (if enabled). 'local-only': must go local; fails closed if local disabled.
config.harmony.creativeServiceUrl.descri: Base URL of the local Harmony Creative service. Used by creative canvas and image-generation tools. Default port 8896.
config.harmony.visual.allowNpxInstall.de: Allow Harmony browser/screenshot tools to download Playwright/Chromium through npm when missing. Disable for offline-only or metered-network sessions.
config.harmony.toolRoutingGuard.descript: When ON (default), Harmony detects when a model describes tool work but forgets to call tools, and automatically retries with a stricter tool-routing reminder. This adds one extra API call per failure but prevents silent stalls. Turn OFF if you prefer manual recovery or want to minimize API costs.
config.harmony.toolResultMaxChars.descri: Maximum characters a tool result may return before Harmony truncates it (applies to read_file, grep, and other tool output). Read fresh on every tool call, so changes apply mid-session. Lower it for smaller context-window models; raise it to return fuller files.
config.harmony.toolResultAutoCap.descrip: When ON (default), Harmony automatically lowers the tool-result cap so a single tool result never exceeds about 40% of the active model's context window. This protects small-context models from overflow while your manual toolResultMaxChars value still wins whenever the model has room to spare. Turn OFF to always use your exact toolResultMaxChars value.
config.harmony.autoRetry.description: When ON (default), Harmony automatically retries once when an API provider connection drops mid-response. Turn OFF for full manual control.

config.harmony.tokenBudget.description: Maximum output tokens per AI call. Higher = longer responses. Model caps respected.
config.harmony.translation.fallbackOrder: Provider fallback order for translation backfill. When a model in the translation pipeline fails, Harmony tries the next provider in this list that has a configured API key. Remove providers you don't want as fallback (e.g. remove claude to avoid costly fallback). Providers without keys are silently skipped.
When ON, Harmony automatically runs a lightweight safety audit on code changes after every chat turn. Uses API calls -- review all provider settings and cost expectations before enabling.
config.harmony.snapshotMaxBytes.descript: Maximum file size (in bytes) for pre-action snapshots. Files exceeding this are edited without a backup snapshot. Default 2MB.
config.harmony.vision.skipOcr.descriptio: When ON, attached images bypass Windows OCR entirely and go directly to your chosen vision provider. Use this to check layout, alignment, colors, or any visual detail without OCR text-extraction race conditions.
config.harmony.flowState.description: When ON, Harmony injects continuous-flow instructions into every turn: auto ask_question, active session pacing, whisper-inbox readiness, and neurodivergent-friendly session design.
config.harmony.vision.fallbackOrder.desc: Fallback order for vision auto mode. Reorder in sidebar or settings.json.
